correctness.rationale: The proof uses the exact SU(2) boundary identity |a|^2+|b|^2=1. Centering |b|^2 at its nonnegative zero Fourier coefficient gives an A1 perturbation h with norm at most B^2. The logarithm therefore converges absolutely, outer spectral factorization controls log a by twice log|a|, and Banach-algebra exponentiation yields ||a^{-1}||_{A1} <= (1-B^2)^(-2). The published March proposition then gives a uniform ell^1 bound for every fixed margin below 1/sqrt(2).
